comments.helnwein: Wind op since below-par latest run; can have a big say if rediscovering previous promise
comments.kidman: 9yo who is 0-8 but consistent, and may be able to build upon his fair chase debut fourth
comments.netywell: Three wins last winter but has struggled the last twice and needs to get back on track

races.raceComment: realstone is marginally preferred with a score of 64.8%, holding clear edges in better ratings and better suited by conditions and more progressive and more reliable profile over bollingerandkrug. Won 2 of last 6 starts. Ground (Good To Soft) looks ideal with 5 wins from 12 starts in similar conditions. Strong pace likely with multiple front-runners. Excellent course form of 5/16 at kelso. Key attributes include optimal distance and improving.

verdict.comment: Improving novice chaser BILLYTHEREALBIGRED (nap) holds particularly strong claims and is first choice ahead of Kandoo Kid.

comments.beaubalko: Getting no help from the assessor but is a consistent sort who should give his running
comments.billytherealbigred: Record of 112 since switched to fences; solid effort in notable novice handicap last time
comments.boosterbob: Not progressing as expected over fences and has something to prove back up in distance
comments.iroko: Gives the impression there's still more to come from him; first preference is 1:45 Kelso
comments.kandookid: Landed the big 3m2f handicap here in November; ran well in this race last year; respected
comments.kotmask: Disappointing last time when failing to confirm December placings with Scarface
comments.lemilos: Won the big 3m2f handicap here in 2022 and 2m4f veterans' event at Warwick last month
comments.lightnstrike: On a difficult mark returned to chasing and needs to prove he retains ability
comments.midnightriver: Successful in notable handicaps in 2022-23 season; hasn't looked the same horse since
comments.paintthedream: Record of 3-4 over fences at Newbury includes an easy success in this contest in 2022
comments.princequali: Generally consistent; could go well, provided he takes to first-time cheekpieces
comments.saintsegal: Scored comfortably over C&D on penultimate start; creditable second at Musselburgh latest
comments.scarface: Best form this term includes a second-place finish over C&D; each-way possibilities
comments.spyglasshill: Veteran who faces a difficult task on belated reappearance; debut for new yard
comments.tedley: Has respectable form but looks more exposed than the other novice chasers in this field
comments.vincenzo: Has form figures of 121 since switched to fences; back up in trip but looks interesting

races.raceComment: beaubalko is marginally preferred with a score of 65.5%, holding clear edges in more progressive over kandookid. Won 1 of last 6 starts. Strong pace likely with multiple front-runners. Excellent course form of 5/18 at newbury. Key attributes include strong course form and improving, though step up in class need consideration.

verdict.comment: The 7yo CALCUTTA DREAM has seemed suited by a drop back in distance lately and can follow up January's win at Southwell.

comments.annaleelass: Latest win came at Wolverhampton three weeks ago; unlikely to be far away
comments.calcuttadream: First win at 1m when scoring at Southwell in January; leading contender again
comments.conquestofpower: Scored over 1m at Lingfield and followed up over 6f here; thriving; impossible to discount
comments.jemsbond: Gained reward for consistency when scoring over C&D two weeks ago; in the mix again
comments.martinsbrig: Dual C&D winner last year; running respectably of late and could make the frame again
comments.popfavorite: Multiple C&D winner; neck second here nine days ago; another who should be on the premises
comments.retirementbeckons: Popped up at 50-1 over C&D last March but has been mostly below par since
comments.topguntina: 14-race maiden who had no obvious excuses behind Jems Bond here last time
comments.wheresthecrumpet: Both AW wins have been here but her last three runs have been some way below par

races.raceComment: martinsbrig is marginally preferred with a score of 54.0%, holding clear edges in more proven at trip and more progressive over jemsbond. Placed in 2 of last 6 starts. verdict.comment: Preference is for LUMENBOURG, who hit a personal best with his brave win at Southwell two weeks ago and is only 2lb higher.

comments.alfieboy: Well held in last three Flat runs and was pulled up on hurdling debut latest; opposable
comments.bobbyjoeleg: 14-time winner but last success was 13 months ago and he's been well held here last twice
comments.brokenspear: Last win was in May 2023 and he was out of sorts in his final three runs last year
comments.lumenbourg: Hit personal best with his brave win at Southwell and is only 2lb higher; key player
comments.madeall: Regressive 12-race maiden who has finished down the field in both runs after wind surgery
comments.saisonsdor: Generally reliable veteran who has won three times over C&D; respected on his return
comments.tomorrowday: Five course wins (6f/7f) since September and was close fourth here on Thursday; respected
comments.yorkstone: Well treated on old form but he's struggled since returning from a break in October

comments.cusack: Course specialist who won over C&D last month and was second over 1m2f latest; respected
comments.edenstorm: Unexposed at this trip and was an eyecatcher off reduced mark at Wolverhampton; dangerous
comments.hartswood: Won over C&D last month before his second in a Class 5 at Southwell; in the mix again
comments.lennemi: Back on track with second behind Hartswood over C&D last time; could make a bold bid
comments.parislights: Can miss the break but he won over C&D in December and was second here latest; key player
comments.thatsmyboyluke: Eight-race maiden who was in rear here last time; headgear is now added back in trip
comments.volenti: Held over 1m2f latest but he's won four times over C&D since October; respected back at 1m

Ground (Standard) looks ideal with 3 wins from 11 starts in similar conditions. Strong pace likely with multiple front-runners. Key attributes include optimal distance, though unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.

verdict.comment: Robert Cowell saddles two likely candidates but MOULIN BOOJ returns to action from a fair mark and could progress further this year.

comments.blindbeggar: Not at very best over C&D last time but this winter's best runs give him solid claims
comments.monnaslieve: 11 defeats since debut win; should be well treated but not a solid option in new blinkers
comments.mondammej: Four Newcastle wins since November 23; needs to rebound from lacklustre run nine days ago
comments.moulinbooj: C&D winner; ended 2024 with two good AW runs; likely to be heavily involved
comments.readyfreddiego: Last summer's best gives him claims but no great record fresh & no headgear for his return
comments.rhythmnhooves: Two good runs over C&D on his last two starts; likely to be in the shake up again
comments.thefixer: Not matched French form since joining this yard; tumbled down weights; check betting
comments.ziggysmissile: Two C&D wins last March; good 2nd on return in November; held in Class 3 twice since

races.raceComment: rhythmnhooves is marginally preferred with a score of 51.4%, holding clear edges in better suited by conditions and stronger recent form over blindbeggar. Won 1 of last 6 starts. Strong pace likely with multiple front-runners, though unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile and regressive form need consideration.

verdict.comment: Andrew Balding colt HEBRIDEAN NOMAD has had his latest 1m4f course third boosted and shapes as if 1m6f will suit him.

comments.cinnodin: Didn't show much on reappearance but this former C&D winner is back on a good mark
comments.dancetime: 2m course win in December and fair third back here (2m again) since; respected
comments.fashionelle: Novice win came over 9.4f but 2m4f hurdle success provides hope she can stay 1m6f on Flat
comments.fastfred: Second leg of autumn hat-trick came over 1m4f here; in form since but stamina not assured
comments.hebrideannomad: Stuck on for third behind subsequent winners over 1m4f here latest; 1m6f should suit
comments.moelarthur: Won over 2m at Lingfield in January but not in the same form when fourth there since
comments.roguetornado: Pulled up over hurdles latest but third to Dance Time over 2m here before that
comments.seethegreen: Flat/hurdle winner but 8l fifth back on the Flat here (1m4f) last week
comments.swinginglondon: Dual C&D winner this winter; respected back at 1m6f after finding 1m4f too sharp latest

races.raceComment: swinginglondon is marginally preferred with a score of 59.2%, holding clear edges in more progressive and more reliable profile over dancetime. Won 1 of last 6 starts. Strong pace likely with multiple front-runners. Key attributes include optimal distance and improving, though unfavorable draw need consideration.

verdict.comment: The lightly raced CHARMAINE (nap) makes the most appeal. She's well bred and promises to be suited by today's longer distance.

comments.caramay: Five wins in last six months but mark has risen and others are preferred for win purposes
comments.charmaine: Came up short in valuable race at Lingfield but this is less competitive; still unexposed
comments.kinetic: Prominent racer who goes well on this course, third last time; should be thereabouts
comments.nowhere: Folded tamely to finish last of nine on stable debut and needs a transformation
comments.sidsannie: Disqualified for causing trouble at Kempton latest; up 2lb but should remain competitive
comments.therapist: Just 1-13 on the Flat but she's consistent and in the mix once more

races.raceComment: caramay is marginally preferred with a score of 61.0%, holding clear edges in better suited by conditions and superior course form and more progressive and more reliable profile over kinetic. Won 2 of last 6 starts. Ground (Standard) looks ideal with 5 wins from 14 starts in similar conditions. Strong pace likely with multiple front-runners. Excellent course form of 6/23 at southwell. Key attributes include optimal distance and improving, though step up in class and unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.

verdict.comment: Lion's Dream is respected but IGNAC LAMAR has a fine strike-rate in course handicaps and can follow up his recent win here.

comments.coppermountain: Both Southwell wins at 1m and it's a long time since she's shone over 7f
comments.embarked: C&D winner in September; well below that level since and well held here last week
comments.goldengoose: Little so far but well connected and has several AW winners in immediate family
comments.greciangod: Off the mark over 7f in August; things not always gone to plan since; 5lb lower than win
comments.ignaclamar: Made it 3-4 in course handicaps when C&D winner last month; very likely to go well again
comments.lionsdream: Sole win on 3yo debut; close 4th over C&D last month; better than subsequent defeat
comments.mickeymongoose: Both AW wins over 1m here; having first C&D run when well held latest; needs more
comments.myboyjack: All 3 wins at Wolverhampton but rarely far away on this track in the last 2 years
comments.samshope: Won over 7f on AW last March; low key for this yard; down weights; had second wind surgery

races.raceComment: myboyjack is marginally preferred with a score of 51.0%, holding clear edges in more progressive over ignaclamar. Placed in 3 of last 6 starts. Strong pace likely with multiple front-runners, though unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.

verdict.comment: Back Tomorrow isn't handicapped out of things but the addition of a hood could spark extra from the free-going TANTOMILE.

comments.backtomorrow: Three Wolverhampton wins this year; not seen to best effect the last twice; contender
comments.caesarspearl: Placed over C&D in November but unable to build on it in three runs since
comments.chesterlestreak: Well handicapped for stable debut; the market can guide back from 543 days off
comments.doontheglen: 0-22 but has run well over C&D in the past; will probably need a pace collapse to win
comments.kohanagirl: 11-race maiden; snippets of form but looks opposable for win purposes
comments.mayremain: December's fourths bring him into it but he's been quiet at a low level in 2025
comments.mrstanley: Exposed 27-race maiden; has shown some promise but others look safer for the win
comments.porthedland: Disappointing for H Candy; has ability and new yard may find the key to him; no tongue tie
comments.tantomile: Near miss at Newcastle before having excuses last time; new hood should help; contender
comments.ustath: Prolific winner down the years; latest 7f third was encouraging; return to 6f a plus

races.raceComment: backtomorrow is marginally preferred with a score of 50.8%, holding clear edges in better ratings and better suited by conditions and stronger recent form over ustath. Won 3 of last 6 starts. Ground (Standard) looks ideal with 5 wins from 13 starts in similar conditions. Strong pace likely with multiple front-runners, though unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile and regressive form need consideration.
